revision_scope: Exact-head focused regressions, API checks and vet passed. Broader sweeps and their start revisions are recorded separately. Only this report is committed after tested_revision.

scope_items.change: Every occupancy interval has starts_at, ends_at and all_day. The flag is the sole widening of 2h times-only disclosure; no event, matter, kind, attendee or video metadata is exposed. REST, MCP, kit types and real-core fixture agree.

Only active attendee users count as assigned. Walled events with no active attendees appear in occupancy and per-user busy with the restricted shape; reactivation hides them on the next read unless the existing per-user attendee rule includes them. Other walls, windows, ordering and pagination remain in force. Both stores use current user state; lookup errors fail closed.

Optional persisted video object with required requested boolean, nullable provider, nullable active core host UUID and nullable opaque meeting id (200 Unicode characters maximum). Invalid video returns invalid_input. PATCH omission preserves, null clears, an object replaces. Location remains the join link. Read/list/create/update and typed kit support are covered. Existing calendar notifications carry record references; recipients fetch video through normal scoped reads just as other fields. No notification envelope or event grant was widened.

Both frame bridges use live authenticated resolution for cross-module targets. Enabled source/target, staff viewer, declared staff tab and an approved link in either direction are required. Query and message params are filtered against target tabs[].params. Unlinked/disabled/client-tab/widget/external/traversal targets are refused; current same-module/core refusals are retained.
